scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run check:names && npm run check:braces && npm run check:backend && vite build
scripts.deploy:test: npm run version:bump && npm run build && firebase hosting:channel:deploy test --expires 30d
scripts.deploy:live: npm run version:bump && npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.deploy:ghpages: npm run version:bump && npm run build && gh-pages -d dist --dotfiles --message "Deploy build"
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-stmina "EXPECT=new node tools/rules-tests/users-self-edit.mjs && EXPECT=new node tools/rules-tests/servants-manager.mjs && EXPECT=new node tools/rules-tests/parts-edit.mjs && EXPECT=new node tools/rules-tests/occasions.mjs"
